name: Arcades Sabboth
description: Arcades Sabboth is a wise white Elder Dragon, the older brother of Nicol Bolas and Ugin, who ruled humans as Dragonlord and became de facto ruler of Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Chromium pledges to Faralyn and befriends Ravidel; Arcades Sabboth is killed by Kristina.
timeline.quote: Chromium once again pledged allegiance to a planeswalker

citation.text: "Chromium Rhuell", section "Serving Faralyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The war spreads across the seas, and Arcades Sabboth joins, listening to Bolas's whispers.
timeline.quote: Even the wise Arcades Sabboth threw his might into the great war

citation.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "The spreading of the War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the last clash on Jamuraa, Ugin's intervention saves Sabboth; Bolas's spark ignites in rage and envy and he planeswalks away, ending the war.
timeline.quote: Only the unexpected intervention of Ugin prevented the ultimate defeat of Sabboth.

citation.text: "Elder Dragon War", section "The last clash". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Bolas wins the Elder Dragon War and his own spark ignites in envy of Ugin.
timeline.quote: in rage and envy of Ugin's newly-revealed planeswalker status, Bolas's own spark ignited

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Elder Dragon War and ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Trapped in the Shard during the Ice Age, Leshrac summons an elder dragon against Kristina of the Woods and plans to conquer Shandalar with Tevesh Szat.
timeline.quote: He wanted to conquer that mana -rich plane , and allied with Tevesh Szat to achieve this.

citation.text: "Leshrac", section "The Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the vision, a blind great shadow beats its wings and drops egg-stones from which dragons wake, as Arcades Sabboth, Chromium Rhuell and Palladia-Mors name themselves.
timeline.quote: By naming itself it takes control of its own destiny.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Two large egg-stones crack into the ground without waking, and Palladia-Mors dismisses them as weak and goes hunting.
timeline.quote: These two were too weak to wake up. Good riddance.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins find Arcades Sabboth ruling a human settlement.
timeline.quote: To our surprise our sibling Arcades Sabboth had taken up residence inside the great ring wall.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol burns a tower and soldiers when humans shoot at the twins, and Arcades slams into him.
timeline.quote: His blast of fire breath scorched along the highest tower and its adjoining wall walk.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Nicol takes the name Nicol Bolas and the twins are admitted to the colony as Arcades's guests.
timeline.quote: I am Nicol Bolas,

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: the twins live for years in the colony, Ugin befriending the holy elder Te Ju Ki.
timeline.quote: I poked my snout into everything, and made particular friends with an old holy elder named Te Ju Ki

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Arcades dismisses Ugin's concerns, and Ugin leaves Te Ju Ki to follow Nicol.
timeline.quote: I know where he's going. I must follow him.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Dragons fight across the world and Arcades Sabboth joins the war after hearing whispers of wisdom.
timeline.quote: threw his might into the great war as he listened to the whispers of wisdom that brushed through his mind

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin appears between the warring armies of Nicol and Arcades on Jamuraa and demands they stop.
timeline.quote: Nicol! Arcades! You must put a stop to this! It's wrong!

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he killed the sorcerers around him and founded academies, then fought wars with his siblings until Arcades retreated and Ugin returned in the middle of the final battle.
timeline.quote: One day, when I had finally driven that stubborn tyrant Arcades into retreat, Ugin returned.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Bolas visits Arcades's kingdom, hears he last saw Ugin long ago, and plants doubts in his mind about his subjects.
timeline.quote: I insinuated a worm of doubt in his haughty mind

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Perspectives" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2018.

timeline.summary: Arcades goes to investigate human structures, takes up residence in a ring fort as worshiped Dragonlord and teaches them a better way of life.
timeline.quote: He took up residence in a ring fort, where the humans worshiped him as their "Dragonlord".

citation.text: "Arcades Sabboth", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Listening to Bolas's whispers, Arcades throws his might into the Elder Dragon War.
timeline.quote: Arcades Sabboth threw his might into the Elder Dragon War

citation.text: "Arcades Sabboth", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arcades's army fights Bolas on Jamuraa until Ugin appears; Arcades uses the distraction to retreat.
timeline.quote: their battle was interrupted by Ugin 's appearance

citation.text: "Arcades Sabboth", section "Elder Dragon War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Bolas gone after igniting his spark, Arcades takes over the land and welcomes Bolas's abandoned armies, becoming de facto ruler of Dominaria; Bolas turns his regime into a police state.
timeline.quote: He became the de facto ruler of Dominaria until his death

citation.text: "Arcades Sabboth", section "Aftermath of the war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.quote: He was killed by Kristina , in her duel with Leshrac in 2834 AR .
